segments.text: Here is your metformin, five hundred milligram tablets.
Take one tablet in the morning and one tablet in the evening, with food.
Common side effects can include an upset stomach or feeling sick, so taking it with food helps.
If you miss a dose, take it when you remember, but do not take two together.
Keep the tablets in a cool dry place.
